title: The open thread's title on the Messages page shows a bar on its left edge

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan saw it on the review server. components/newsroom-organizer.css gives every [aria-current=true] and [data-selected=true] in the newsroom an inset 3px bar; the selected thread's title button has aria-current=true. Fix excludes [data-conversation-card] and [data-conversation-open] (the ring is their mark). New scenario noEdgeMark in scripts/test-messages-page.ts loads the real organizer stylesheet inside .newsroom-organizer; it failed before the fix.
